analytics.conditions: X-ray powder diffractometry, Cu-K-alpha radiation (1.54178 Angstrom), 25 deg C
analytics.raw_text: X-ray powder diffraction diagram of form C. The table at lines 225-233, repeated at 235-243, gives seven reflections as 2-theta values with their interplanar spacings d: 2-theta from 7.4 to 33.6, each stated as +/- 0.2, and d from 12.00 down to 2.67 Angstrom. The patent recites at least 3, often at least 5, and especially all seven.

notes: Crystalline form C of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form C. The section is a powder diffraction table for form C and names no other substance; the 2-theta values, spacings, radiation and wavelength are measurements and instrument settings, not compounds. is_section_product is false because this section only characterises the form and no step of it produces anything.
